content.title: -ing 与不定式作宾语·doing / to do 速查
content.intro: 有些动词后面只能接 doing,有些只能接 to do,还有一组接两者意义不同。判断口诀:看前面的主句动词;意义变化组再看句子语境是'未做/已做'。

rows: enjoy / finish / avoid / mind / practise / suggest / consider / keep / give up:She enjoys writing stories.
decide / hope / agree / promise / manage / offer / refuse / want / learn / fail:He decided to keep writing.
remember / forget / regret / stop / try / mean:remember to do(未做) vs remember doing(已做)
stop to do = 停下来去做另一件事;stop doing = 停止正在做的事

specialRules.rule: remember/forget/regret + to do 指'该做、还没做';+ doing 指'已经做过'
specialRules.mark: Remember to post it(还没寄) / I remember posting it(寄过了)

specialRules.rule: stop to do = 停下来去做;stop doing = 停止做某事
specialRules.mark: He stopped to rest(停下休息) / He stopped swimming(不再游泳)

specialRules.rule: try to do = 努力设法;try doing = 试着做(看效果)
specialRules.mark: try to finish(竭力做完) / try looking on the bright side(试着换个角度)

specialRules.rule: mean to do = 打算;mean doing = 意味着
specialRules.mark: I meant to help(本打算) / Success means trying again(意味着)

why: doing 强调动作本身或经历(已发生/正进行),to do 强调一次具体的、往往尚未发生的动作或目的;主句动词的性质决定了它后面要搭配哪一种,意义变化组则进一步靠语境区分'未做'还是'已做'。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空高频:给出动词原形,按主句动词判断填 doing 还是 to do。
remember/forget/stop/try + doing vs to do 的意义辨析是改错与单选常考点;尤其 stop to do 与 stop doing。

examVsReal.exam: I enjoy reading.（考试要求 doing）
examVsReal.real: I love to read. / I love reading.
examVsReal.note: 考试里 enjoy 只能接 doing;但 love/like/begin/start 两种都行,口语里更随意

examVsReal.exam: Remember to lock the door.（考试强调未做）
examVsReal.real: Don't forget the door! / Lock up, yeah?
examVsReal.note: 考试看 to do/doing 辨意;真实口语常省略动词、直接点到名词或短句
